name: User can submit the contact form and sees a success message
description: Filling in name, email and message and submitting the contact form replaces the form with the confirmation "Thank you! Your message has been sent." and a Send another message button.

planSteps.description: Scroll down to the Contact us section
Type Jane Doe into the Name field
Type jane@example.com into the Email field
Type Hello, I have a question about my order. into the Message field
Wait about two seconds for the submission to finish
Verify the Contact us section now shows a success confirmation with the text: Thank you! Your message has been sent.
Verify the Contact us section shows a Send another message button in place of the Name, Email and Message fields
